releaseNotes: External workbook links: Open Manage Workbook Links now really opens Excel's Edit Links dialog — and when Excel cannot show it (a cell is being edited or the workbook is protected), the exact reason appears instead of silence.

External workbook findings gain Open Source Workbook: the linked source is brought forward when it is already open, opened otherwise, and when the file is missing or unreachable the resolved path is shown with clear next steps — never a silent click.
Every Workbook Audit action now reports its result on the window's status strip — successes and refusals are always visible, so no action can silently do nothing.
Undo can no longer run while a scan is in progress, and apply/undo reliably restore Excel's screen state even when a write fails.
Exports say exported-to-Excel only when the export actually completed.
The circular-reference cycle viewer opens as a proper Elmashad window owned by Excel, with member-by-member navigation that returns cleanly to your workbook.
Schedule Health results clear when the project changes, a card whose project has closed explains why it cannot open, and Quick Clean restores Excel's screen state on any failure.
Title-bar icons now render on every Elmashad window, and the Settings page shows its Saved confirmation.
